in_hebrew.name: Yule
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Ancient pagan festival of the solstice
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Yule הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English word ‘giel’ meaning ‘wheel’ and ‘geol’ meaning ‘year’. Yule was the ancient pagan festival celebrating the solstice, the return of the sun, and the beginning of the new year. This name carries a rich history of spiritual and cultural significance.
